title: Regular Morley tetrahedra from $p$-secting planes
summary: Morley's theorem says that the adjacent angle trisectors of a triangle meet in the vertices of an equilateral triangle. Tran carried the construction to a tetrahedron by trisecting its six dihedral angles and, more generally, by $p$-secting planes, with one parameter $e,f,g>1$ for each pair of opposite edges; the resulting tetrahedron is denoted $\mathcal M_{e,f,g}(ABCD)$.
